hooks.text: A twelve-year cosmic voyage is hunting down a record eight asteroids.
A spacecraft carrying real diamonds is chasing ancient fossils in space.
It isn't just an asteroid flyby when the moon is a contact binary.

title: The Record-Breaking 12-Year Asteroid Tour
description: NASA's Lucy spacecraft is on a twelve-year voyage to explore a record-breaking eight different asteroids.

beats.text: A twelve-year cosmic voyage is hunting down a record eight asteroids.
beats.visual: Artist concept of NASA Lucy spacecraft in deep space, 2021

beats.text: Launched on October sixteenth, 2021, the ambitious Lucy mission set out across the solar system with a unique cargo on board.
beats.visual: Atlas V rocket launch carrying Lucy spacecraft, 2021

beats.text: Named after famous hominin fossils, the spacecraft carries an actual disc made entirely of lab-grown diamonds.
Its ultimate target is six Jupiter trojan asteroids trapped securely in the giant planet's orbit.
beats.visual: Jupiter Trojan asteroids Lagrange points diagram

beats.text: Along the way, principal investigator Harold Levison guided the probe right past main-belt asteroid Dinkinesh.
beats.visual: Asteroid Dinkinesh and satellite captured by NASA, 2023

beats.text: High-resolution cameras revealed a tiny moon orbiting the rock that was actually a rare contact binary.
beats.visual: NASA image of asteroid Dinkinesh binary satellite, 2023

beats.text: That surprising hidden moon officially started this record-breaking twelve-year cosmic voyage.
beats.visual: Artist concept of Lucy spacecraft near an asteroid, 2021
